anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in close-quarters physical confrontation: one swings a bat-like object while the other adopts a defensive stance, with contact implied by proximity and motion blur.
A man on the right fires a handgun at a woman on the left; visible muzzle flash and smoke confirm discharge.
A man is shown holding a handgun pointed forward, with his finger on the trigger and arm extended; the framing and posture are consistent with an imminent or ongoing gunshot.
The man swings a dark object (likely a baton or pipe) downward toward the woman, who is in close proximity and appears to be reacting defensively; this constitutes a physical assault attempt.
The man is seen grabbing the woman’s head/neck area from behind while she is bent over, indicating a non-consensual, forceful act against a vulnerable individual.
